verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document dashboard subscriptions, scheduled report delivery, or alerts on abnormal metric movement. It covers shareable reports, machine-learning insights for anticipating customer actions, and a Data API that developers could use to build custom dashboards or automation. These are adjacent features or developer building blocks, not the named capability.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can subscribe to dashboards and get alerted when a key metric moves abnormally
